t: Vehicle modules are screen modules for interacting with a Mover Controller. Use a module on a Mover Controller to bind it.
载具模块是专为与传运器控制器交互而设的屏幕模块。将模块右键点击传运器控制器，即可完成绑定。
The control module can send a vehicle to a selected Mover. The status module displays vehicle information on an RFTools screen.
控制模块可向选定的传运器发送载具；状态模块则可在RF工具箱屏幕上显示载具信息。
